Step back in time and delight in the ambience of a 16th century castle. RavenStone Castle stands majestically on a hillside mile south of Route 14 on Illinois Route 23 in Harvard, Illinois. Stay in one of our themed rooms and enjoy a European-styled breakfast, book a Tea Party for that special occasion or take a tour on one of our event days . We hope to see you soon!
We can make your occasion special!
Whether you're looking for a weekend away from the city, a unique place for your special occasion or a birthday party that your little princess will never forget, RavenStone Castle can help you forge memories that will last a lifetime.
RavenStone Castle is the perfect venue for everything from a private party to a quaint wedding.
Discover all that RavenStone Castle has to offer.
Come spend the night
Looking for something different? RavenStone Castle offers numerous bed and breakfast amenities and a variety of affordable, specially-themed rooms .

About Us
RavenStone Castle is more than a family home. It's a castle with 16th century style, modern conveniences and detailed craftsmanship.
RavenStone Castle History
In 2001, Jose and Rose Michel broke ground on their dream home - a castle in the 16th century style. Truly making the house their own, Rose designed each room, arch and turret.
With plans in hand, the Michel family - including four sons and a daughter - built the castle from the ground up. They rented equipment, excavated the basement, set forms and poured concrete. While they were framing the roof, they realized they could see all the way to the grocery store in Harvard.
Another pleasant surprise was how everyone's natural talents surfaced as they worked on the interior details of the castle. Together they built something much more than just a house. Amazing craftsmanship and a unique design await you.
RavenStone Castle is filled with antiques and unique pieces from all over the world.  We hope you will visit and enjoy the Michel Family's dream.

Bed & Breakfast
Each of RavenStone Castle's spacious guestrooms is individual in design and furnished with a specially-themed decor. Rooms all feature central air conditioning and heating. All guests are invited to a European-style breakfast each morning.
Please note, we are unfortunately unable to accomodate children under the age of 12 or dogs.
Queen Elizabeth's Room
Queen Elizabeth's Room features two twin beds. A private bath is located just a few short steps away, and guests also have access to a whirlpool tub.
Rate: $175/night
King Arthur's Room
King Arthur's Room features a queen-size bed and a sitting area. The suite also boasts a private bath with shower.
Rate: $195/night
Egyptian Suite
The spacious Egyptian Suite boasts a queen-size bed and a sitting area. It also features a private bath and a whirlpool tub within the room. A private balcony overlooks the countryside.
Rate: $225/night
